title: gramark-cst
description: The generic concrete syntax tree a Gramark recognizer builds with no semantic actions: a branch per reduced production (tagged with its gramark-ir rules[] index) and a token leaf per consumed terminal, children in source order. This is the action-free, portable artifact every backend can emit and any host can walk. cstVersion 0 is draft/unstable and carries no compatibility promise.

node.description: A CST node is either an interior branch or a terminal leaf.

branch.description: A reduced production. `rule` is the index into gramark-ir grammar.rules; `children` are the right-hand-side nodes in source order (possibly empty only for an epsilon production, which the epsilon-free Core never emits).

token.description: A consumed terminal leaf. `token` is the terminal name (a literal spelling or an ALL-CAPS lexer class); `text` is the matched source slice.
